# Keeper Headshots

> Keeper Headshots (keeperheadshots.com) is an online AI headshot studio. You upload a few selfies and get studio-quality professional headshots in a few minutes, for LinkedIn, résumés, company websites and print. Every photo is checked before rendering, every headshot is scored for likeness against your own photos, and the set is graded so you know which one to use. The first shoot is a free preview (keep it for $8.99); paid packages are one-time payments from $29.99, with no subscription.

## How it works

1. Create an account and confirm your email address.
2. Upload one to six recent photos where your face is clearly visible. An AI photo check reviews them in seconds and says what to fix.
3. Choose up to four looks (a backdrop and an outfit, e.g. Studio Gray with a navy suit, Library with a black turtleneck).
4. The studio develops two headshots per look, usually within a few minutes. Each one is checked for likeness and retaken automatically if it drifts.
5. An AI retoucher grades every headshot (likeness, polish, lighting), picks the best one and says where each works best.

Every headshot downloads as a full-resolution 3:4 portrait (websites, print, business cards, résumés) and a 1:1 square framed for round profile photos (LinkedIn, Microsoft Teams, Slack).

## Pricing

- Free preview shoot: up to 2 looks, after confirming your email. Keep the preview's headshots at full resolution for $8.99, or for $14.99 with 2 more looks added to the same shoot; any package also includes them.
- Starter: $29.99 one-time, 3 shoots (up to 24 headshots).
- Professional: $39.99 one-time, 6 shoots (up to 48 headshots). Most popular.
- Executive: $49.99 one-time, 12 shoots (up to 96 headshots). About $4 a person for teams.
- Each paid shoot has up to 4 looks and 8 headshots. Shoots don't expire while the account is open.
- Money-back guarantee on the first paid package: if none of the headshots from the first paid shoot are usable, tell us within 30 days for a refund, less any later shoots kept.

## Privacy

- Photos are never used to train AI models and never used in marketing unless the customer chooses to share one.
- You own your headshots and can use them anywhere, including commercially.
- Shoots, or the whole account, can be deleted at any time; deleting removes selfies and headshots straight away.
- Keeper Headshots is based in Iowa, USA. Contact: hello@keeperheadshots.com
